units.text: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding; to receive instruction in wise dealing to give prudence to the simple that the wise man may hear to understand a proverb

My son If they say let's swallow them up alive like Sheol We'll find all valuable wealth. We'll fill our houses with spoil. You shall cast your lot among us. We'll all have one purse. My son for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood. For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives. So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
Honor Yahweh with your substance so your barns will be filled with plenty

Listen for I give you sound learning. Don't forsake my law. For I was a son to my father He taught me Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don't forget Don't forsake her Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes Esteem her She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.

Listen I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths. When you go Take firm hold of instruction. Don't let her go. Keep her Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of evil men. Avoid it For they don't sleep For they eat the bread of wickedness But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don't know what they stumble over.

My son Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the midst of your heart. For they are life to those who find them Keep your heart with all diligence Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you. Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you. Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established. Don't turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
My son You are trapped by the words of your mouth. You are ensnared with the words of your mouth. Do this now Give no sleep to your eyes Free yourself

A worthless person who winks with his eyes in whose heart is perverseness Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes haughty eyes a heart that devises wicked schemes a false witness who utters lies
They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
If you seek her as silver
that he may guard the paths of justice
Then you will understand righteousness and justice
For her good profit is better than getting silver
Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
Don't withhold good from those to whom it is due
Don't devise evil against your neighbor
Yahweh's curse is in the house of the wicked
The wise will inherit glory
lest strangers feast on your wealth
provides her bread in the summer
so your poverty will come as a robber
For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
Receive my instruction rather than silver; knowledge rather than choice gold.
I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
With me are riches
My fruit is better than gold
That I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.
Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.
Treasures of wickedness profit nothing
He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand
Blessings are on the head of the righteous
The rich man's wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
Yahweh's blessing brings wealth
A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh
Riches don't profit in the day of wrath
By the blessing of the upright
Wicked people earn deceitful wages
People curse someone who withholds grain
He who diligently seeks good seeks favor
He who trusts in his riches will fall
He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
The thoughts of the righteous are just
He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread
A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man's hands shall be rewarded to him.
The hands of the diligent ones shall rule
The slothful man doesn't roast his game
The soul of the sluggard desires
There are some who pretend to be rich
The ransom of a man's life is his riches
Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away
Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline
Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children
An abundance of food is in poor people's fields
Every wise woman builds her house
The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
The house of the wicked will be overthrown
The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
The simple inherit folly
The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor
In all hard work there is profit
The crown of the wise is their riches
He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker
In the house of the righteous is much treasure
The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch
Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud
He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house
Honest balances and scales are Yahweh's; all the weights in the bag are his work.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes
It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor
He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns
An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
Whoever rewards evil for good
He who justifies the wicked
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom
A man void of understanding strikes hands
One who has a perverse heart doesn't find prosperity
One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
The rich man's wealth is his strong city
A man's gift makes room for him
A man's stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
The poor plead for mercy
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
Wealth adds many friends
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
House and riches are an inheritance from fathers
Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
A corrupt witness mocks justice
Wine is a mocker
The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest
Differing weights and differing measures
There is gold and abundance of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Fraudulent food is sweet to a man
Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning
Yahweh detests differing weights
The king's heart is in Yahweh's hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked
Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor
A gift in secret pacifies anger; and a bribe in the cloak
It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
He who loves pleasure shall be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil shall not be rich.
There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
The desire of the sluggard kills him
There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don't withhold.
A false witness will perish
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
A good name is more desirable than great riches
The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth
The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
The sluggard says
Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich
Don't exploit the poor
Don't you be one of those who strike hands
If you don't have means to pay
Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won't serve obscure men.
Don't weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom
Don't eat the food of him who has a stingy eye
Don't move the ancient boundary stone. Don't encroach on the fields of the fatherless:
for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
Don't be among ones drinking too much wine
for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
Don't look at the wine when it is red
Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
A wise man has great power; and a knowledgeable man increases strength;
for by wise guidance you wage your war; and victory is in many advisors.
for there will be no reward to the evil man; and the lamp of the wicked shall be snuffed out.
Prepare your work outside
Don't be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don't deceive with your lips.
I went by the field of the sluggard
so your poverty will come as a robber
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
As an earring of gold
As the cold of snow in the time of harvest
Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor's house
A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club
The sluggard says
The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.
Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
Don't forsake your friend and your father's friend. Don't go to your brother's house in the day of your disaster: better is a neighbor who is near than a distant brother.
Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain
for riches are not forever
There will be plenty of goats' milk for your food
A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
Evil men don't understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity
He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
He who conceals his sins doesn't prosper
A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
To show partiality is not good; yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
A stingy man hurries after riches
One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
The king by justice makes the land stable
The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren't concerned about knowledge.
The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.
The king who fairly judges the poor
When the wicked increase
A dishonest man detests the righteous
Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me;
The leach has two daughters: 'Give
For a servant when he is king; a fool when he is filled with food;
for an unloved woman when she is married; and a handmaid who is heir to her mistress.
Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish; and wine to the bitter in soul:
The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
She considers a field
She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn't go out by night.
She lays her hands to the distaff
She opens her arms to the poor; yes
She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
She looks well to the ways of her household
Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
